data.narrative:
Modern Intelligence, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by John Dulin, Joe Cieslik, and Tristan Tager, has raised $5.12M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage cohort, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $13M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—produces a $1.0B median with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range of $11M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $506M. The disparity reflects substantial stage and maturity variance within the peer set; the Seed-stage stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while the peer median is heavily influenced by later-stage Series A valuations and outlier performances. Key uncertainties include Modern Intelligence's differentiation relative to the broader Defense & Security cohort and the appropriate stage-adjustment discount from Series A peers.
